33032.context: They need someone who is going to love them and protect them and nourish them, not someone who is going to see them as someone who has to get the evil expelled from them. Your home is a collection of sinners saved by real grace. You must all, all of you, everybody in your home must look to Christ, because doing so is absolutely necessary. But you're not going to look to Christ. The good news is not going to make any sense unless you have internalized the bad news.

34130.context: I use the label apostate to take back its ownership, because apostate or murted are often used against us as insults. Whatever work I do to take back that label, I have to first undo all the harm that he's done to tarnish it. And that's really unfortunate, because he started off by helping so many people, so it's sad to see him fall from grace like that. Like I said, this isn't exclusively an AP problem, but he's the most prominent example. The way I see it, the underlying problem is hate, and I'm not validating the false accusation that we're inundated with, that critics of Islam do it because they're hateful.
